plugin.name: ChaosCast
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Tracks chaos portal casts - normal vs golden
plugin.description: Tracks how many chaos portals you cast, and what percentage are normal vs golden. Commands: chaoscast - Show stats chaoscast help - Show help chaoscast reset - Reset stats chaoscast rooms - List mapper rooms the last portal could lead to

trigger.match: With a blinding flash of light, you have created a chaos portal!
trigger.name: chaos_normal

trigger.match: The chaos portal flares with a golden aura!
trigger.name: chaos_golden

muclient.script:
-- ───────────────────────────────────────────── -- ChaosCast - MushClient Plugin -- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
local dataFile = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) .. "ChaosCast.dat"
local stats = { total = 0, normal = 0, golden = 0, continent = 0, area = 0 } local pendingGolden = false local gtBroadcast = true -- gt broadcast toggle local roomList = true -- auto-list possible destination rooms after each portal
local CONTINENTS = { ["alagh, the blood lands"] = true, ["gelidus"] = true, ["the continent of mesolar"] = true, ["the dark continent, abend"] = true, ["the southern ocean"] = true, ["the uncharted oceans"] = true, ["vidblain, the ever dark"] = true, }
local function IsContinent(area) return CONTINENTS[area:lower()] == true end
-- ─── Persistence ─────────────────────────────
local function SaveData() local f = io.open(dataFile, "w") if f then f:write(string.format("total=%d\nnormal=%d\ngolden=%d\ngtbroadcast=%d\ncontinent=%d\narea=%d\nroomlist=%d\n", stats.total, stats.normal, stats.golden, gtBroadcast and 1 or 0, stats.continent, stats.area, roomList and 1 or 0)) f:close() end end
local function LoadData() local f = io.open(dataFile, "r") if f then for line in f:lines() do local k, v = line:match("^(%a+)=(%d+)$") if k and v then if k == "total" or k == "normal" or k == "golden" or k == "continent" or k == "area" then stats[k] = tonumber(v) elseif k == "gtbroadcast" then gtBroadcast = (tonumber(v) == 1) elseif k == "roomlist" then roomList = (tonumber(v) == 1) end end end f:close() end end
-- ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────
local function Pct(part, total) if total == 0 then return "0", "00" end local p = (part / total) * 100 local whole = math.floor(p) local frac = math.floor((p - whole) * 100) return string.format("%d", whole), string.format("%02d", frac) end
-- Shorthand: ColourNote takes (fg, bg, text, fg, bg, text, ...) -- colour names: "white", "red", "cyan", "green", "black" local BG = "black"
local function CN(...) ColourNote(...) end
-- ─── Display ─────────────────────────────────
local function ShowStats() local nW, nF = Pct(stats.normal, stats.total) local gW, gF = Pct(stats.golden, stats.total) local cW, cF = Pct(stats.continent, stats.total) local aW, aF = Pct(stats.area, stats.total)
CN("green", BG, "Chaos Portals Cast")
CN("white", BG, "Total Portals: ", "red", BG, tostring(stats.total))
CN("white", BG, "Normal Portals: ", "red", BG, tostring(stats.normal), "white", BG, " (", "cyan", BG, nW, "white", BG, ".", "cyan", BG, nF, "white", BG, "%)")
CN("white", BG, "Golden Portals: ", "red", BG, tostring(stats.golden), "white", BG, " (", "cyan", BG, gW, "white", BG, ".", "cyan", BG, gF, "white", BG, "%)")
CN("white", BG, "Continent Lands: ", "red", BG, tostring(stats.continent), "white", BG, " (", "cyan", BG, cW, "white", BG, ".", "cyan", BG, cF, "white", BG, "%)")
CN("white", BG, "Area Lands: ", "red", BG, tostring(stats.area), "white", BG, " (", "cyan", BG, aW, "white", BG, ".", "cyan", BG, aF, "white", BG, "%)") end
local function ShowHelp() CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast Help") CN("white", BG, "chaoscast ", "cyan", BG, "- Show portal cast statistics") CN("white", BG, "chaoscast help ", "cyan", BG, "- Show this help message") CN("white", BG, "chaoscast reset ", "cyan", BG, "- Reset all statistics") CN("white", BG, "chaoscast rooms ", "cyan", BG, "- List mapper rooms the last portal could lead to") CN("white", BG, "chaoscast rooms all ", "cyan", BG, "- Same, but list every match (or 'rooms <number>')") CN("white", BG, "chaoscast rooms on|off ", "cyan", BG, "- Auto-list those rooms after every portal") CN("white", BG, "chaoscastbc ", "cyan", BG, "- Toggle gt broadcast on/off") CN("white", BG, "chaoscast <channel> ", "cyan", BG, "- Broadcast stats to a channel (eg: chaoscast gt)") CN("white", BG, "bcp <number> ", "cyan", BG, "- Cast chaos blank X times with 1 second delay (eg: bcp 10)") CN("white", BG, "bcpstop ", "cyan", BG, "- Stop an in-progress BCP run") Note("") CN("green", BG, "RaviTrack") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack ", "cyan", BG, "- Show Ravi portal purchase statistics") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack help ", "cyan", BG, "- Show RaviTrack help") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack reset ", "cyan", BG, "- Reset Ravi purchase stats") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack <channel> ", "cyan", BG, "- Broadcast Ravi stats to a channel (eg: ravitrack gt)") end
-- ─── Trigger Handlers ────────────────────────
function OnNormalPortal(name, line, wildcards) pendingGolden = false end
function OnGoldenPortal(name, line, wildcards) pendingGolden = true end
function OnPortalDestination(name, line, wildcards) local room = wildcards[1] local area = wildcards[2] local isGolden = pendingGolden pendingGolden = false
stats.total = stats.total + 1 if isGolden then stats.golden = stats.golden + 1 else stats.normal = stats.normal + 1 end if IsContinent(area) then stats.continent = stats.continent + 1 else stats.area = stats.area + 1 end SaveData()
local goldFlag = isGolden and "Y" or "N"
if gtBroadcast then local goldCode = isGolden and "@x048" or "@x099" Execute("gt @WArea: @x048" .. area .. "@x045 | @WRoom: @x048" .. room .. "@x045 | @YGold: " .. goldCode .. goldFlag .. "@w") end
-- Show which mapped rooms this portal could lead to (clickable gotos). CC_PortalDestinationRooms(room, area)
-- Advance a running BCP: this portal landed, so cast the next one. BcpOnPortalRecorded() end
-- ─── BCP Bulk Cast ─────────────────────────── -- -- Event-driven: cast one chaos blank, then WAIT for the portal to -- actually be created (recorded in OnPortalDestination) before casting -- the next. This respects the cast's round-time instead of spamming on -- a blind timer. A watchdog re-casts if a cast silently fails, and the -- 'active' flag lets bcpstop halt cleanly.
local bcp = { active = false, remaining = 0, total = 0 }
local BCP_DELAY_SEC = 1 -- pause after a portal lands before next cast local BCP_WATCHDOG_SEC = 6 -- if no portal appears this long, re-cast
local function BcpClearTimers() DeleteTimer("bcp_watchdog") DeleteTimer("bcp_next") end
-- Cast one, and arm a watchdog in case the cast produces no portal. function BcpDoCast() if not bcp.active then return end Execute("c chaos blank") AddTimer("bcp_watchdog", 0, 0, BCP_WATCHDOG_SEC, "", bit.bor(timer_flag.Enabled, timer_flag.OneShot, timer_flag.Temporary, timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed, timer_flag.Replace), "BcpDoCast") end
-- Timer callback for the pause between a landed portal and the next cast. function BcpNext() BcpDoCast() end
-- Called from OnPortalDestination when a portal is successfully recorded. function BcpOnPortalRecorded() if not bcp.active then return end DeleteTimer("bcp_watchdog") bcp.remaining = bcp.remaining - 1 if bcp.remaining <= 0 then bcp.active = false BcpClearTimers() CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "BCP complete. Cast ", "red", BG, tostring(bcp.total), "white", BG, " portals.") else AddTimer("bcp_next", 0, 0, BCP_DELAY_SEC, "", bit.bor(timer_flag.Enabled, timer_flag.OneShot, timer_flag.Temporary, timer_flag.ActiveWhenClosed, timer_flag.Replace), "BcpNext") end end
function OnBcpCast(name, line, wildcards) local n = tonumber(wildcards[1]) if not n or n < 1 then CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "Usage: bcp <number> eg: bcp 10") return end
bcp.active = true bcp.total = n bcp.remaining = n
CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "Starting BCP — casting ", "red", BG, tostring(n), "white", BG, " portals (waiting for each to land).")
BcpDoCast() end
function OnBcpStop(name, line, wildcards) bcp.active = false bcp.remaining = 0 BcpClearTimers() CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "BCP stopped.") end
-- ─── Destination Room Lookup ───────────────── -- -- The portal line tells us the destination room NAME and AREA, but not which -- specific room uid it drops you in — and a name like "Ghostly Sands" repeats -- many times inside an area. So look the pair up in the mapper's own sqlite -- database and print every candidate as a clickable "mapper goto <uid>" link, -- styled like the mapper's own 'mapper find' results. That lets you see (and -- walk to) where the portal goes without spending the portal. -- -- rooms.area holds the area KEYWORD ('alagh'); areas.name holds the display -- name the MUD prints ('Alagh, the Blood Lands'), so we accept either.
local MAPPER_ID = "b6eae87ccedd84f510b74714"
local ROOM_LIST_LIMIT = 20 -- rooms shown by default before truncating local ROOM_LIST_CAP = 200 -- ceiling even for 'chaoscast rooms all' local lastDest = nil -- { room = ..., area = ... } from the last portal
local function SqlStr(s) return "'" .. tostring(s or ""):gsub("'", "''") .. "'" end
local function MapperDbPath() if not IsPluginInstalled(MAPPER_ID) then return nil, "the Aardwolf GMCP mapper plugin is not installed" end local db_name = GetPluginVariable(MAPPER_ID, "db_name") if not db_name or db_name == "" then db_name = (WorldName() or ""):gsub("[^%w%s()_-]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end if db_name == "" then return nil, "could not work out the mapper's database name" end local path = GetInfo(66) .. db_name .. ".db" local f = io.open(path, "rb") if not f then return nil, "mapper database not found at: " .. path end f:close() return path end
-- Returns rows, total, how (or nil, errormessage) -- how: "exact" | "partial" | "anyarea" | "none" local function FindRooms(room, area, limit) local path, why = MapperDbPath() if not path then return nil, why end
local ok, sqlite3 = pcall(require, "sqlite3") if not ok or not sqlite3 then return nil, "the sqlite3 library is unavailable" end
local db = sqlite3.open(path) if not db then return nil, "could not open the mapper database" end
local FROM = " FROM rooms r LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.uid = r.area " local la, lr = area:lower(), room:lower() local areaMatch = "(lower(coalesce(a.name, '')) = " .. SqlStr(la) .. " OR lower(r.area) = " .. SqlStr(la) .. ")" local nameExact = "lower(r.name) = " .. SqlStr(lr) local nameLike = "lower(r.name) LIKE " .. SqlStr("%" .. lr .. "%")
local tries = { { where = areaMatch .. " AND " .. nameExact, how = "exact" }, { where = areaMatch .. " AND " .. nameLike, how = "partial" }, { where = nameExact, how = "anyarea" }, }
for _, t in ipairs(tries) do local total = 0 for r in db:nrows("SELECT count(*) AS c" .. FROM .. "WHERE " .. t.where) do total = r.c end if total > 0 then local rows = {} for r in db:nrows("SELECT r.uid AS uid, r.name AS name, r.area AS areakey," .. " coalesce(a.name, r.area) AS areaname" .. FROM .. "WHERE " .. t.where .. " ORDER BY CAST(r.uid AS INTEGER) LIMIT " .. tostring(limit)) do rows[#rows + 1] = r end db:close() return rows, total, t.how end end
db:close() return {}, 0, "none" end
function CC_ListRooms(limit) if not lastDest then CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "No chaos portal destination seen yet - cast one first.") return end
local room, area = lastDest.room, lastDest.area limit = math.min(limit or ROOM_LIST_LIMIT, ROOM_LIST_CAP)
local rows, total, how = FindRooms(room, area, limit) if not rows then CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "red", BG, "Room lookup failed - " .. tostring(total)) return end
CN("green", BG, "Portal leads to: ", "cyan", BG, room, "white", BG, " in ", "cyan", BG, area)
if total == 0 then CN("white", BG, " Not in your mapper database - you have not walked there yet.") return end
if how == "partial" then CN("white", BG, " No exact name match; showing rooms in that area whose name contains it.") elseif how == "anyarea" then CN("white", BG, " Nothing matched in that area; showing rooms with that name elsewhere.") end
-- mirror the mapper's own underline preference so this looks like 'mapper find' local noUnderline = (GetPluginVariable(MAPPER_ID, "NoUnderline_hyperlinks") ~= "0")
for i, r in ipairs(rows) do local label = string.format("[%d] %s (%s) (%s)", i, r.name, r.areaname or r.areakey, tostring(r.uid)) ColourTell("white", BG, " ") Hyperlink("mapper goto " .. tostring(r.uid), label, "Click to speedwalk to " .. r.name .. " (" .. tostring(r.uid) .. ")", "", "", false, noUnderline) Note("") end
if total > #rows and #rows >= ROOM_LIST_CAP then CN("white", BG, " Showing the first ", "red", BG, tostring(#rows), "white", BG, " of ", "red", BG, tostring(total), "white", BG, " - too many rooms share that name to be worth listing.") elseif total > #rows then CN("white", BG, " ... and ", "red", BG, tostring(total - #rows), "white", BG, " more. Type ", "cyan", BG, "chaoscast rooms all", "white", BG, " to list up to " .. ROOM_LIST_CAP .. ".") else CN("white", BG, " ", "red", BG, tostring(total), "white", BG, (total == 1) and " possible room." or " possible rooms.") end end
-- Called from OnPortalDestination. Always remembers the destination so -- 'chaoscast rooms' works later, but only auto-prints when enabled and when -- a bulk 'bcp' run isn't in progress (that would bury the screen). function CC_PortalDestinationRooms(room, area) lastDest = { room = room, area = area } if not roomList then return end if bcp.active then return end CC_ListRooms(ROOM_LIST_LIMIT) end
function OnChaosCastRooms(name, line, wildcards) local arg = Trim((wildcards[1] or "")):lower()
if arg == "on" or arg == "off" then roomList = (arg == "on") SaveData() CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "auto room list ", roomList and "green" or "red", BG, roomList and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED") elseif arg == "" then CC_ListRooms(ROOM_LIST_LIMIT) elseif arg == "all" then CC_ListRooms(ROOM_LIST_CAP) elseif tonumber(arg) then CC_ListRooms(math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(arg)))) else CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "Usage: chaoscast rooms [all | <number> | on | off]") end end
function OnChaosCastDisplay(name, line, wildcards) ShowStats() end
function OnChaosCastHelp(name, line, wildcards) ShowHelp() end
function OnChaosCastChannel(name, line, wildcards) local channel = wildcards[1]
-- Don't intercept reserved commands if channel == "help" or channel == "reset" or channel == "rooms" then return end
local nW, nF = Pct(stats.normal, stats.total) local gW, gF = Pct(stats.golden, stats.total) local cW, cF = Pct(stats.continent, stats.total) local aW, aF = Pct(stats.area, stats.total)
local msg = "@WChaos Portals @x048Total: @x099" .. stats.total .. "@x045 | @WNormal: @x099" .. stats.normal .. "@W (@x048" .. nW .. "@W.@x048" .. nF .. "@W%)" .. "@x045 | @WGolden: @x099" .. stats.golden .. "@W (@x048" .. gW .. "@W.@x048" .. gF .. "@W%)" .. "@x045 | @WContinent: @x099" .. stats.continent .. "@W (@x048" .. cW .. "@W.@x048" .. cF .. "@W%)" .. "@x045 | @WArea: @x099" .. stats.area .. "@W (@x048" .. aW .. "@W.@x048" .. aF .. "@W%)@w"
Execute(channel .. " " .. msg) end
function OnChaosCastGtToggle(name, line, wildcards) gtBroadcast = not gtBroadcast SaveData() if gtBroadcast then CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "gt broadcast ", "green", BG, "ENABLED") else CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "gt broadcast ", "red", BG, "DISABLED") end end
function OnChaosCastReset(name, line, wildcards) stats.total = 0 stats.normal = 0 stats.golden = 0 stats.continent = 0 stats.area = 0 SaveData() CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "Stats have been reset.") end
-- ─── Plugin Lifecycle ────────────────────────
function OnPluginInstall() LoadData() ravi_load_data() CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast loaded. Type 'chaoscast help' for commands.") end
function OnPluginConnect() LoadData() ravi_load_data() end
function OnPluginSaveState() SaveData() ravi_save_data() end
-- ───────────────────────────────────────────── -- RaviTrack - merged into ChaosCast -- ─────────────────────────────────────────────
local ravi_data_file = "RaviTrack.dat"
local RAVI_TYPES = { "a blank chaos portal", "a blank chaos portal with a silvery tint", "a shiny platinum blank chaos portal", "a glittering diamond blank chaos portal", }
local ravi_counts = { ["a blank chaos portal"] = 0, ["a blank chaos portal with a silvery tint"] = 0, ["a shiny platinum blank chaos portal"] = 0, ["a glittering diamond blank chaos portal"] = 0, }
function ravi_save_data() local f = io.open(ravi_data_file, "w") if not f then return end for k, v in pairs(ravi_counts) do f:write(k .. "|" .. tostring(v) .. "\n") end f:close() end
-- Maps old (pre-fix) capitalized keys to the corrected lowercase keys, so -- counts saved before the case fix aren't silently lost on load. local RAVI_LEGACY_KEYS = { ["A blank chaos portal with a silvery tint"] = "a blank chaos portal with a silvery tint", ["A shiny platinum blank chaos portal"] = "a shiny platinum blank chaos portal", ["A glittering diamond blank chaos portal"] = "a glittering diamond blank chaos portal", }
function ravi_load_data() local f = io.open(ravi_data_file, "r") if not f then return end local migrated = false for line in f:lines() do local name, num = line:match("^(.*)|(%d+)$") if name and num then if ravi_counts[name] ~= nil then ravi_counts[name] = tonumber(num) elseif RAVI_LEGACY_KEYS[name] then local newkey = RAVI_LEGACY_KEYS[name] ravi_counts[newkey] = tonumber(num) migrated = true end end end f:close() if migrated then ravi_save_data() ColourNote("green", "", "[ChaosCast] Migrated legacy Ravi portal counts to corrected keys.") end end
function OnRaviBuy(name, line, wildcards) local portal = wildcards[1] if ravi_counts[portal] ~= nil then ravi_counts[portal] = ravi_counts[portal] + 1 ravi_save_data() end end
function OnRaviTrack() local total = 0 for _, v in pairs(ravi_counts) do total = total + v end
local function pctParts(amt) if total == 0 then return "0", "00" end local p = (amt / total) * 100 local whole = math.floor(p) local frac = math.floor((p - whole) * 100) return string.format("%d", whole), string.format("%02d", frac) end
local blank = ravi_counts["a blank chaos portal"] local silver = ravi_counts["a blank chaos portal with a silvery tint"] local platinum = ravi_counts["a shiny platinum blank chaos portal"] local diamond = ravi_counts["a glittering diamond blank chaos portal"]
CN("green", BG, "Ravi Portal Tracker")
CN("white", BG, "Total Portals: ", "red", BG, tostring(total))
local function RaviLine(label, amt) local w, f = pctParts(amt) CN("white", BG, label .. ": ", "red", BG, tostring(amt), "white", BG, " (", "cyan", BG, w, "white", BG, ".", "cyan", BG, f, "white", BG, "%)") end
RaviLine("Blank", blank) RaviLine("Silver", silver) RaviLine("Platinum", platinum) RaviLine("Diamond", diamond) end
function OnRaviChannel(name, line, wildcards) local channel = wildcards[1] if channel == "help" or channel == "reset" then return end
local total = 0 for _, v in pairs(ravi_counts) do total = total + v end
local blank = ravi_counts["a blank chaos portal"] local silver = ravi_counts["a blank chaos portal with a silvery tint"] local platinum = ravi_counts["a shiny platinum blank chaos portal"] local diamond = ravi_counts["a glittering diamond blank chaos portal"]
local function P(amt) local w, f = Pct(amt, total) return "@W (@x048" .. w .. "@W.@x048" .. f .. "@W%)" end
local msg = "@WRavi Track @x045| @WTotal: @x099" .. tostring(total) .. "@x045 | @WBlank: @x099" .. tostring(blank) .. P(blank) .. "@x045 | @WSilver: @x099" .. tostring(silver) .. P(silver) .. "@x045 | @WPlatinum: @x099" .. tostring(platinum) .. P(platinum) .. "@x045 | @WDiamond: @x099" .. tostring(diamond) .. P(diamond) .. "@w"
Execute(channel .. " " .. msg) end
function OnRaviReset() for k, _ in pairs(ravi_counts) do ravi_counts[k] = 0 end ravi_save_data() CN("green", BG, "ChaosCast: ", "white", BG, "Ravi portal stats reset.") end
function OnRaviHelp() CN("green", BG, "RaviTrack Help") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack ", "cyan", BG, "- Show Ravi portal purchase statistics") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack help ", "cyan", BG, "- Show this help") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack reset ", "cyan", BG, "- Reset all counts") CN("white", BG, "ravitrack <channel> ", "cyan", BG, "- Broadcast stats to a channel (eg: ravitrack gt)") end
